auth-alias.description: Alias of the Shopify account to use for authentication.
auth-alias.name: auth-alias

client-id.description: The Client ID of your app. Use this to automatically link your new project to an existing app. In non-interactive environments, provide this flag or both --name and --organization-id.
client-id.name: client-id

flavor.description: Which flavor of the given template to use. Required in non-interactive environments when the selected template offers multiple flavors.
flavor.name: flavor

json.description: Output the result as JSON. Automatically disables color output.
json.name: json

name.description: The name for the new app. When provided, skips the app selection prompt and creates a new app with this name. Required in non-interactive environments unless --client-id is provided.
name.name: name

no-input.description: Disable interactive prompts and browser authentication.
no-input.name: no-input

organization-id.description: The organization ID. Your organization ID can be found in your Dev Dashboard URL: https://dev.shopify.com/dashboard/<organization-id>. Required in non-interactive environments unless --client-id is provided.
organization-id.name: organization-id

template.description:
The app template. Accepts one of the following:
       - <reactRouter|none>
       - Any GitHub repo with optional branch and subpath, e.g., https://github.com/Shopify/<repository>/[subpath]#[branch]. Required if non interactive.
template.name: template

verbose.description: Increase the verbosity of the output. May include sensitive data.
verbose.name: verbose
